ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert - abnormal token accounting for tenant Cygnus Corp (tenant_id: cyg-84). Detected in VPC dedicated pool dedicated-eu-west-2-3. Avg tokens/request jumped from ~180 to ~4.2k starting 2027-02-14T10:12:08Z. Spike correlated with increased raw byte length. Trace: 0x3fc2a

Ryan (oncall): I'm taking this. Paging @Mia - Infra, @Nora - Eng-ML, and @Sam - CS. Sam, any customer chatter yet?

Sam - CS: Customer flagged a sudden bill preview spike and hit their soft quota alerts. They confirmed heavy webhook ingestion around 10:10 UTC. They pasted two sample payloads that look like mixed encodings (some chars look like mojibake). They requested immediate mitigation.

Mia - Infra: Looking at ingress logs: requests for cyg-84 show header `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-16le` in ~12% of sampled requests, but our gateway assumes UTF-8. If UTF-16 bytes are treated as UTF-8, tokenizers explode. I can see raw request bytes like `ff fe 41 00 6c 00...` being interpreted as separate tokens.

Nora (Eng-ML): That's consistent with an encoding mismatch. Quick repro: sample payload A (correct UTF-8) -> tokenizer tokens = 198. Same payload with UTF-16LE bytes fed as-is -> tokenizer tokens = 3,984. So billing/token accounting is inflated. Two immediate mitigation options: 1) transcode suspect requests to UTF-8 at gateway for tenant cyg-84, or 2) route cyg-84 traffic to a safe fallback model that uses a different tokenizer with less catastrophic tokenization for raw bytes. Recommendation: do (1) as quick fix, (2) schedule (2) for safety.

Jordan (SRE): I'll implement a fast ingress rule to detect non-UTF8-ish payloads and transcode to UTF-8 for that tenant. Plan: add a Lua filter on the ELB proxy to run a quick heuristic (check for BOMs `ff fe`/`fe ff` or high null-byte density) and, if triggered, transcode to UTF-8 and add header `X-Redwood-Transcoded: utf16->utf8`. Also tag these requests with `x-incident-tokenfix: cyg-84`. I'll push a canary to the s3-west host first. ETA ~12m.

Ryan (oncall): Good. Add a feature-flag so we can toggle per-tenant and log counts. Also create a short-lived route to fallback model as backup. Jordan, coordinate with Mia for the canary host list.

Mia - Infra: Canary up: applied Lua filter on proxy s3-west-03. Observability: sample rate 1%. Early asserts: requests flagged=18 in first 3m. Token median for flagged requests before transcode: 2,900; after transcode: 210. CPU/latency impact negligible (+~5ms).

Jordan (SRE): Pushing filter to all egress nodes in dedicated-eu-west-2-3. Rolling in progress. Will tag all transcodes so billing team can exclude them until reconciliation.

Sam - CS: Confirmed customer notified of short-term "input sanitation" change. They accepted and asked that we avoid retroactive billing for these problematic requests. They've sent more sample payloads to help triage.

billing-bot: Billing queue: billing-recon #487 created for tenant cyg-84 to reconcile token accounting for requests with header `X-Redwood-Transcoded`. Owner: @billing-lead. Tentative action: zero out token delta for flagged requests between 2027-02-14T10:12Z - 2027-02-14T11:40Z pending root cause verification.

Nora (Eng-ML): Root cause: customer system started sending utf-16le JSON without proper headers after their library upgrade. Our gateway trusted `charset` header less often; some proxies stripped it. Fixes: 1) add defensive transcode + mark requests (short-term), 2) add decoding detection in the SDK + docs (mid-term), 3) add an ingestion validation rule that rejects ambiguous encodings (long-term). Also adding a unit test suite with mixed encoding samples.

Jordan (SRE): Mitigation rolled out across pool at 10:33 UTC. Post-rollout metrics: flagged requests dropped to normal token counts; overall pool token/sec reverted to baseline. Logging sample after mitigation:

```
[2027-02-14T10:34:12Z] tenant=cyg-84 trace=0x3fc2a request_id=abc123 flags=transcoded tokens_before=3896 tokens_after=210 route=model-open-mirror-7b latency_ms=132
```

Ryan (oncall): Great. Who's owning post-incident tasks? Need: billing reconciliation, root cause PR, SDK docs, customer follow-up, and postmortem.

Sam - CS: I'll own customer comms and follow-up with Cygnus Corp. I will confirm they want the reconciliation and give them ETA.

billing-bot: Billing team assigned @billing-lead and set priority=P1 for recon. Expected initial reconciliation review in 48 hours.

Nora (Eng-ML): I'll open PR to add the encoding-detection helper into gateway and a small fuzzy-detector in tokenization path to avoid future surprises. Also will add telemetry counters for BOMs and null-byte density. PR draft: https://git.internal/repo/eng-ml/encoding-guard/pull/521

Jordan (SRE): Creating incident ticket INC-2027-212 for timeline + artifacts. Handoff to on-call rotation: @Ryan -> @Jordan at 11:00 UTC. Adding runbook steps and mitigations to the incident doc.

Ryan (oncall): Handing off to Jordan; I'll be on standby for escalations. Closing alert in monitoring now.

ops-bot: Incident update: mitigated (transcode) in dedicated-eu-west-2-3; customer impact: billing spike prevented from escalating further, temporary customer quota bump applied. Next steps assigned: Sam (customer comms), Nora (PR + tests), Jordan (postmortem + runbook), billing-lead (recon).

Jordan (SRE): Postmortem owner assigned to me. We'll aim for a short postmortem doc within 72 hours and a full blameless postmortem with timeline and remediation within 7 calendar days.

Sam - CS: Customer confirmed they won't pursue charges once we reconcile; asked for a short summary for their compliance team. I'll attach postmortem once available.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status: mitigated; channel will remain open for updates until postmortem published.
